newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Yapi Kredi issues $150 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Turk Yapi Kredi issues $150 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Yapi ve Kredi Bankasi (YKB), one of Turkey's leading banks, said it completed a $150 million, five-year debut Eurobond issue via lead manager UBS Limited.
It said the bond was priced at a re-offer spread of 395 basis points and carried 10 percent semi-annual coupon interest.

"The Eurodollar issue is a debut transaction for Yapi ve Kredi Bankasi in the international capital markets and the first US$ non-sovereign Turkish issue in the US dollar Eurobond markets," the bank statement said.
The issue was placed primarily with retail and institutional accounts in Europe, southeast Asia and offshore US, YKB said.
BCP, Chase, Commerzbank, CSFB, ING Barings, Lehman Brothers, Salomon Brothers and SBC Warburg acted as co-managers.

YKB operates with 388 retail and 26 corporate branches, four offshore banking services, representive offices in Cologne, Stuttgart, Munich, London, New York and Moscow and a joint venture investment banking subsidiary in Russia.
